description: This file contains implementation details for affine quantizer base functionalities in PyTorch, including template functions for quantization and dequantization, with conditional compilation depending on whether FBGEMM is used or ARM NEON intrinsics are available.

methods.name: void checkZeroPoint(const std::string & fn_name,int64_t zero_point)
methods.description: Checks if the zero_point is within the valid range for type T.

methods.description: Templates for value quantization, conditionally compiled with or without FBGEMM support.

methods.name: void quantize_vec(double scale,int64_t zero_point,const float * src,T * dst,size_t count)
methods.description: Quantizes a vector of floats into a template type T using a specified scale and zero point.

methods.name: dequantize_val(double scale,int64_t zero_point,T value)

methods.name: int quantize_val_float_qparams(float scale,float zero_point,float value,int qmin,int qmax)
methods.description: Quantizes a float value into an integer within specified min and max, using scale and zero point as parameters.

methods.description: Requantizes a value from source scale/zero_point to destination scale/zero_point.
